title: Decal not appearing, related to editor cache
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.7dev2

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev2 - Artix Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC on Tty - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti (nvidia; 580.119.02) - AMD Ryzen 5 2600 Six-Core Processor (12 threads) - 31.28 GiB memory

### Issue description

Decal doesn't work, unless I delete the `.godot/editor` folder. Probably related to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/117568
Not a serious problem since there is a workaround (deleting `.godot/editor`), but worth looking into imo

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new 3D Scene
2. Create a new Plane Mesh (optionally increase the mesh size)
3. Create a new Decal
4. Assign an albedo texture to the Decal

In every version (4.6, 4.7dev2 etc) the above is deterministic and works. 
Here, however my `.godot/editor` folder somehow bugs it out, see below.
Note that this MRP is the main project (1.9 GB) slimmed down, but it wasn't anything wild. It had some models, some animations, a directional light, and a path3D. That said, when I delete these for this MRP, it is a bug if the editor cache, still affects the project and needs a full `.godot/editor` wipe.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[47decal-cache-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26119894/47decal-cache-mrp.zip)
